about: Routing check for the methods rung. Each question names the analysis method that should answer it, or null when the recipe tiers or the takeover rung should answer it instead. Written 2026-11-14 before any of these wordings were run; none was used to tune the wording gate or the menu. Scored on which rung and method answered, not on the figures: each method's figures are computed by its own code.
